children: Moderna shares plunged after details from a closely guarded mRNA-based cancer-vaccine study were shared on social media.
Moderna's stock fell around 25%, putting the Cambridge, Mass., biotech on pace for its largest decrease since it went public.

In August, Moderna and its partner Merck said the vaccine had prevented melanoma from returning or spreading. The result was hailed as remarkable, though experts cautioned it was critical to see the details in the study, which was scheduled to be released on Saturday at the European Society for Medical Oncology conference.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
